text: So we, if we observe the blots, blemishes, shortcomings, and imperfections of our private selves, shall perceive clearly that we do not need a friend who shall bestow upon us praise and panegyric, but one that will reprove us, and speak plainly to us.
author: Plutarch
locator: How One May Discern a Flatterer from a Friend, Sec. XXV
